rule: UK mainland towns and cities with usual resident population greater than 10000. England and Wales use Census 2021 built-up areas. Scotland uses Census 2022 localities.

sources.note: ONS Census 2021 built-up area usual residents, tables 1c (England excluding London) and 1d (Wales). Counts are the published ONS-rounded figures.
ONS Census 2021 TS001 usual residents (household plus communal establishment) for London boroughs. ONS does not identify individual London settlements in the built-up area tables.
NRS Census 2022 locality usual residents (popcount). Localities are the named towns and cities. A wider settlement that only passes 10,000 by joining neighbouring villages is not added on its own.

not_in_this_slice: Northern Ireland is not on the UK mainland, so it is not included.
